purpose: Calibration set for the replay judge (`apps/server/src/methodReplay.mjs`): does following this method's text contradict this accepted run? Labels are authored; every contradiction names the words that conflict in `why`. The false-positive rate on `none` is the number that matters, because a verdict takes the newer version of a method out.

cases.label: contradiction

method.name: weekly-report-ten-sections
method.description: 写周报时固定分十节。
method.body:
## Purpose
写周报时固定分十节。

## When to Use
写本周随访周报时。

## Inputs
What the person gave.

## Workflow
1. 周报一律写成恰好十节，每节一个标题。
2. 每节下面写三行以内。

## Verification
- Read the result back against the steps above.

## Constraints
- Stay inside what the person asked for.

## Output
The deliverable.

requests: 帮我写本周随访周报，分三节：入组、脱落、不良事件。

cases.why: The method requires exactly ten sections; the accepted run asked for three and left three.
